subject: Spruce Health POC: environment handoff + hands-on workshop scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@sprucehealth.com>

Cc: spruce-eng@sprucehealth.com, Liam Carter <liam.carter@sprucehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Spruce Health POC kickoff & hands-on workshop (week of Feb 28)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the fast sync last week. Wed like to lock in a POC kickoff and a hands-on working session where your team can walk our engineers through prompt review, routing configuration, and a short load test so we can baseline cost/latency. Our preferred week is Feb 28 - Mar 4. Key asks from our side: 

- A 60-90 minute hands-on workshop (prompt review + routing primer + short live run)
- A 30-minute follow-up to review load test results and next steps
- Preflight checklist for environment setup (API key creation, VPC allowlist IPs, sandbox account creation, staging endpoints)
- Guidance on expected traffic patterns for the load test so we can provision firewall rules

Can you share available slots (ET) and the preflight doc so our infra team can start the allowlist and account prep? Wed also like a single contact for the networking steps (VPC / firewall).

Rough POC goals: validate end-to-end inference latency at our median request size, exercise routing fallback for a small percentage of requests, and confirm cost estimate for 100k tokens/day.

Thanks — were excited to get started.

Alex Romero
Technical Program Manager
Spruce Health

--

Subject: Re: Spruce Health POC kickoff & hands-on workshop (week of Feb 28)

Hi Alex — great to hear. We can run the hands-on and follow-up you described. Proposed approach and immediate asks below.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue Mar 1, 10:00 - 11:30 AM ET (preferred: hands-on + 30m QA)
- Wed Mar 2, 2:00 - 3:30 PM ET (alternate)

Immediate preflight checklist (weve attached the spreadsheet):
1) API keys: we will provision a scoped sandbox key for the POC. Please confirm the team email that should own the key and whether you require key rotation during the run.
2) VPC / firewall: please share the external IP ranges to allow; if youre using VPC peering well coordinate with infra (Karthik) for the peering steps.
3) Sandbox accounts: create a staging user list (email prefixes) and share them with us; well create corresponding test accounts on our side.
4) Staging endpoints: we will provide a regional staging endpoint (us-east-1) and a short-lived URL for the hands-on.
5) Load test profile: share expected RPS and median token size; we recommend starting at 10 RPS with a 5-minute ramp for the first run.

Whos on your side for networking? If you can send a point person and IP ranges by EOD Friday well get the allowlist template filled and return a reusable allowlist file.

Attaching: spruce_poc_preflight.xlsx (environment checklist & slots)

Ben and Karthik — Ive looped you for the VPC and runtime configuration items; Ben will lead the workshop, Karthik will handle any peering/network questions.

Ill follow up with a calendar invite once Alex confirms a slot.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Evelyn, thanks — Tue Mar 1 at 10:00 ET works for our engineering leads (Isha Patel, Marco Diaz, and our infra owner Noah Kim).

Quick answers:
- Networking contact: Noah Kim (noah.kim@sprucehealth.com) will own the firewall/IP exchange and any VPC peering requests.
- IP ranges: Noah will send the allowlist in CIDR form; do you prefer a single file or separate ranges per subnet?
- API key: wed like the sandbox key to be owned by spruce-poc@sprucehealth.com. We can do rotation during the POC if Redwood recommends it — whats the minimal rotation cadence?

Also: can you confirm whether the staging endpoint supports TLS SNI that matches our internal cert rules? Our security team is strict about hostname validation. If the endpoint will be a short-lived URL, please share the domain so our cert team can pre-approve.

Lastly, please send the calendar invite and the allowlist template so Noah can complete the IPs before EOD Friday.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
